title: Agent Configuration
description: Settings for configuring an AI agent.

id.help: A unique identifier for this agent. This ID is used to reference the agent throughout the system.

name.help: A human-readable name for the agent, used for display and easy identification.

description.description: Description of the agent's purpose and capabilities.
description.help: A comprehensive description of the agent's role, what tasks it can perform, and its general operational scope. This helps users understand the agent's functionality.

type.help: The type of the agent. This field determines the core behavior and capabilities of the agent, such as how it processes requests or interacts with users. 'DEFAULT' represents a general-purpose agent.

model.description: Language model configuration for the agent.
model.help: Specifies the configuration for the language model that powers this agent. This includes details like the model ID, system prompt, and context management strategy.

sessionStore.description: Session storage configuration for the agent.
sessionStore.help: The configuration for the session management system or mechanism used by the agent to store and retrieve conversational state and history. This enables the agent to maintain context across multiple interactions.

SessionServiceConfig.title: Session Service Configuration
SessionServiceConfig.description: Configuration options for storing conversation sessions.

type.help: Specifies the type of session service to use. 'memory' stores sessions in memory, 'mongodb' stores sessions in MongoDB.

InMemorySessionServiceConfig.title: In-Memory Session Configuration
InMemorySessionServiceConfig.description: Configuration for storing sessions in memory.

type.help: Indicates that the session service uses in-memory storage.

MongoSessionServiceConfig.title: MongoDB Session Configuration
MongoSessionServiceConfig.description: Configuration for storing sessions in MongoDB.

type.help: Indicates that the session service uses MongoDB for storage.

connectionString.description: MongoDB connection string for session storage.
connectionString.help: Connection string for connecting to the MongoDB instance used for session storage.

AgentModelConfig.title: Agent Model Configuration
AgentModelConfig.description: Configuration for the language model used by the agent.

modelId.description: ID of the model configuration to use.
modelId.help: The unique identifier of the specific ModelConfig that this agent should utilize for all its language model functionalities, such as generating responses or understanding queries.

systemPrompt.description: Initial prompt for the model conversation.
systemPrompt.help: An initial, guiding prompt or instruction set provided to the model at the very beginning of a conversation. This helps to establish the model's persona, define its task, or set specific behavioral constraints.

role.description: Agent's role in conversation (e.g., system, user, assistant).
role.help: Defines the conversational role of the agent within a multi-turn dialogue. This influences how the agent interprets incoming messages and how it should format its own responses (e.g., 'system' for initial instructions, 'user' for user input, 'assistant' for AI responses).

contextManagerConfig.help: Configuration for how the agent's model manages its conversation context.

type.help: Specifies the strategy for managing conversation history. 'LAST_N' keeps only the most recent messages.

LastNContextManagerConfig.title: Recent Messages Context Configuration
LastNContextManagerConfig.description: Configuration for keeping the last N messages in context.

type.description: Keep last N messages context manager.
type.help: This context manager type retains a fixed number of the most recent conversation turns.

keepLast.description: Number of recent messages to keep in context.
keepLast.help: The maximum number of recent messages to include in the context for subsequent model interactions.
